currency_basis: Editorial USD interpretation of New York official dollar-denominated fares
unit: per full-fare rider, chargeable subway/local-bus fare trip before cap
source_findings: MTA describes a rolling seven-day cap starting at first tap, stable method identity, separate first-trip methods before bank authorization and up to four riders on a later trip. No precise wait duration is guaranteed here.
OMNY group FAQ limits cap accrual and free rides to the first tap; other taps remain full fare. A physical card and its mobile-wallet version accrue separately.
OMNY weekly page's example uses3USD ordinary tap fare and35USD cap, not the3.50USD non-reusable Single-Ride ticket or36USD proposal. Scope excludes express/airport/commuter/ferry fare comparisons.

family_task.decision: Budget four full-fare riders' NYC subway/local-bus trips using separate consistent methods versus one shared method
family_task.hypothesis: One shared weekly cap makes all four riders free after the threshold
family_task.result: REJECT; IMPLEMENT conditional96/140 versus96/161USD fare-only table and first-use/method-identity limits
